temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is primarily driven by hospital demands, and that Gary may benefit from a short break if encouraged.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's refusal confirms that his work obligations are intense and that he is reluctant to step away, despite Ethan's concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is deeply overcommitted and at risk of harming his health, and that simply inviting him to rest may not be enough.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and somewhat disappointed or frustrated.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue supporting Gary and find another way to help him reduce overwork and consider rest.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. When Ethan gently confronts him, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked mainly because of hospital demands, though Gary has been reluctant to open up about it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's restlessness, avoidance of work talk, and vague response make Ethan suspect there is more than professional obligation behind Gary's overwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary may be hiding personal or emotional burdens and that his overwork has deeper, more complicated causes.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently and offer nonjudgmental support so Gary feels safe opening up.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their confrontation, Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he is facing. Gary is receptive when Ethan suggests prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspects Gary's overwork has deeper personal or emotional causes beyond ordinary hospital demands.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's disclosure explains the reasons behind his overwork and shows that he is willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's situation is understandable and that Gary can improve his work-life balance with practical support and planning.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule to make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary and hears about his progress and remaining challenges. Gary reports feeling less overwhelmed and says he even had time for a movie recently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is working toward better balance but may still need ongoing support and encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's reports and visible efforts show that the support is helping and that Gary is making real progress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is on a positive path toward healthier work-life balance and that continued encouragement is helpful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, encouraging Gary, and offering support when needed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary thanks Ethan, says he feels more in control, and appears capable of managing on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been making steady progress but may still benefit from regular support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's sustained adjustment and sense of control show that he can now manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary has achieved a healthy balance and no longer needs active support, though Ethan remains available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back and let Gary manage independently while remaining available if Gary ever needs him.
